summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests MOMA-341, a drug taken by mouth, alone or with irinotecan or immunotherapy, in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have MSI-H or dMMR changes, including endometrial, colorectal and gastric cancers. MOMA-341 is given orally in 21-day cycles alone or with immunotherapy, and in 28-day cycles with irinotecan, which is given by IV infusion; total treatment duration is not stated. The study is designed to assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and early clinical activity, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa MOMA-341, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, solo o con irinotecán o inmunoterapia, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que presentan alteraciones MSI-H o dMMR, incluidos los cánceres de endometrio, colorrectal y gástrico. MOMA-341 se administra por vía oral en ciclos de 21 días solo o con inmunoterapia, y en ciclos de 28 días con irinotecán, que se administra por infusión intravenosa; la duración total del tratamiento no está indicada. El estudio está diseñado para evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la actividad clínica preliminar, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Unresectable advanced or metastatic solid tumor with MSI-H or dMMR, histologically confirmed.
Progressed on a prior anti-PD-(L)1 regimen, unless ineligible or without access to these therapies.
At least one lesion at baseline suitable for imaging; ECOG performance status 2 or less.
Recovered from prior therapy, radiotherapy or surgery; agrees to contraception and written consent.
not_for: Active advanced-stage malignancy, with some early-stage cancer exceptions.
Clinically relevant cardiovascular disease or CNS metastases with progressive neurological symptoms.
Known uncontrolled infection, allergy to MOMA-341, or GI impairment affecting absorption.
Pregnant or breastfeeding; HIV, active liver disease, or other factors the investigator judges disqualifying.
